license.description: Index-time validated. Only CC0/public-domain records are admitted.

kind.description: kit = composable modular pack (best for environment scaffolding); model = single asset

description.description: Plain-text description for keyword/vibe search now, embedding search later.

categories.description: Provider-native categories (broader than tags; used for filtering/facets).

grade.description: Optional quality grade. Default (absent) = ungraded, treated as silver. 'archive' records are demoted from default search results but never deleted.

grade_reason.description: Short justification when grade is assigned (e.g. 'low-res textures', 'community-enhanced v2').

generated_by.description: If AI/procedurally generated: the model/tool + version (e.g. 'TRELLIS-2024-12'). Required for AI-generated contributions.

provenance.description: Enhancement lineage. Present when this record supersedes an earlier version; the original is archived, never deleted.

original_id.description: id of the archived record this enhances

files_api.description: Optional API endpoint that resolves download URLs per format
